name: LHI-AHA Summer Research Scholars Program (high school)
org: University of Minnesota Medical School, Lillehei Heart Institute
what_you_do: High school scholars work full time for 8 weeks in a heart research lab at the University of Minnesota. They also go to a research event. It is called Cardiopalooza.
who_can_apply: Must be 16 or older, a current junior or senior at the time of application, and a U.S. citizen.
pay_detail: Scholars earn an hourly wage; the amount is not stated.
duration: 8 weeks, May 31 to July 23, 2027 (tentative), 40 hours a week
deadline_text: Applications open Dec 1, 2026 and close Feb 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Add a resume that lists your test scores, a transcript and two letters from faculty. Also add a statement of interest and a statement of goals.
notes: No housing or meals are provided. Applicants under 18 need an adult chaperone for University housing, or can stay off campus with family or friends. Number of spots is not stated.
